title: Higher-Codimension Algebraic Cycle Synthesis on General Projective Varieties via Iterated Clifford-Fredholm Divisors
description: Formal machine-verified Lean 4 proof and numerical probes extending Subtractive Spectral Holography to arbitrary codimension p using iterated Clifford algebras and multivariable Poincare-Lelong exactness. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
